ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to check in at a bar with your crew, and to share it during a party if you turn that on. It is checked, then deleted.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera adds photos to the party album, seen by your crew only.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Your photos fill the party album, seen by your crew only. Their location is removed.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: The calendar gets the parties you add to it. Nothing else is read.
ios.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: The calendar gets the parties you add to it. Nothing else is read.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: With the night out nudge on, your location is read in the background in the evening to see if you've settled somewhere. It stays on this phone, nothing goes to the server.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: With the night out nudge on, your location is read in the background in the evening to see if you've settled somewhere. It stays on this phone, nothing goes to the server.
